documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter/Half Year Ended 30 September 2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited held its second analyst and investor meet for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores and PBT of Rs. 45 crores for FY26. Management highlighted strong volume-driven performance in the water business and recovery in construction chemicals and distribution during the second half of the year, despite a temporary impact on margins from surging raw material costs. The company remains positive on its long-term growth outlook, aiming for an aspirational Rs.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue outlook continues to remain positive.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

guidance.claim: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

guidance.claim: Management expects H2 to grow at a steady rate in the water treatment chemical business.
guidance.quote: So we hope H2 would be we also be growing at a steady rate.

guidance.claim: Management hopes that the second half for construction chemicals would perform better than the first half.
guidance.quote: So this first half year that is quarter one and quarter two. The sales are mostly affected by a monsoon. Prolonged monsoon had affected our sales but the trend is now on the growing side. So we hope it's to would be much better than each one.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that construction chemicals and distribution segments will go up in Q3 and Q4.
guidance.quote: So Construction chemical was down by 6% and distribution by 30%, but yes, we expect in Q3 and Q4 these segments would go up.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive for all business units.
guidance.quote: and the revenue outlook remains positive for all our business units.

guidance.claim: Management noted that approximately 40% to 50% of the new order book in the water business will be invoiced within the financial year.
guidance.quote: So that's how we look at almost invoicing almost around 40 to 50% of this order in within this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching a thousand crore milestone in about four years.
guidance.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a healthy enquiry pipeline for the water business unit.
demand_outlook.quote: also we have a healthy enquiry pipeline which is ongoing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed stability in the supply chain with equipment and system deliveries on schedule.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing stability in our supply chain and equipment and system deliveries are also on schedule.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that activities in construction chemicals are picking up from September onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: So from September onwards we are seeing a growth in construction chemical business, our material cost, our gross profit margins are stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the water treatment specialty chemicals market in India is around Rs. 9500 crores and projected to grow at a 5.2% CAGR for the next five years.
demand_outlook.quote: See, the water treatment speciality chemicals business. If you look at the entire market within India is almost around Rs. 9500 crores. That is $1 billion. And the recent study and research shows that this would grow at the CAJR of 5.2% for the next five years,

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that when costs increase, it takes about a couple quarters to pass them on fully.
margins_costs.quote: It takes us about a couple quarters to pass them on fully.

margins_costs.claim: Improved margins resulted from lower raw material costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Material costs increased due to the war impact alongside volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that consolidated EBITDA for Q2 was up by 14% due to good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: For Second quarter 25-26, I've consolidated EBITDA was at Rs.11.08 crores, which was up by 14% as compared to Second quarter of last financial year. EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Management attributed improved margins to lower raw material costs and new product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in and our outlook remains positive across all business units.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that target margins in the tender business are in the range of 8 to 10%.
margins_costs.quote: margins yes, we are working in the range of 8 to 10% and we would continue to try and improve those margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the water business is starting the financial year with a strong order book for chemicals and equipment systems.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: Equipment and systems deliveries are running on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported a strong order booking in the water business unit for the current financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: This is on account of strong order booking what we have received in current Financial year also we have a healthy enquiry pipeline which is ongoing.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the water business unit has almost Rs. 100 plus crores of new order book apart from regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the new order book comprises approximately Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 crores in chemicals and Rs. 10 to Rs. 12 crores in equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: We have almost Rs. 100 plus CR order book which includes chemical as well as equipment’s almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they maintain a tight credit policy with days sales outstanding around 88 days for construction chemicals.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that material costs started increasing from the end of February and March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that public sector units refused to amend terms under the force majeure declaration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Public sector is a different story. They are refusing to amend the terms.

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction chemicals activity experienced a prolonged monsoon before picking up post-monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that sluggish industrial growth and project delays contributed to lower invoicing in the equipment business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second is that there has been a sluggish growth in the end on the industrial front in which we operate some of the projects have been delayed quite a lot and we could not invoice those projects which are getting.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited pricing pressure from small startups and new entrants breaking market prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: People who moved away from multinationals or even Indian bigger companies starting their own startups. They continuously keep on breaking the price in the market, so we need to keep on competing with them also. So the margins pressure is always there

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an aspirational target of reaching 1000 crores within four years.
management_commitments.quote: in the previous call, you had said that you aspire to test 1000 quotes as a company within four years specifically.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to hold investor calls twice a year.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to have these twice in a year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
